issue.description:
ADR-005 records that an operator who legitimately parks an issue under an assignee has no way to mark the hold intentional, so doctor's ready_frontier warning fires on every run and trains operators to ignore it. Design and land an explicit hold annotation: settable and clearable via `bead update`, carried through checkpoint publication and audit events, surfaced in show/list/doctor; the warning then covers only unexplained holds. Distinct from `manual_blocked`, which encodes a blocked bead rather than a held assignment. Doctor stays advisory-only per the ADR — it never sets or clears the marker itself.

Created by: weave strand

Scope: the first publication of an existing workspace under set-v2 is a documented full rewrite — `sync --status` reports the pending upgrade (current mode, target mode, full-rewrite notice) before it happens, and the root help, README, and generated `sync` man page state the one-time cost proportional to store size. Migration is crash-safe by the §7.4 ordering: the set/ tree is fully written and verified before the pointer swap; a crash before the swap leaves the old layout authoritative with orphans reaped later. - Scoped tests pass; fmt and clippy clean on touched targets.
